hypotheses.A0_discovery_is_task_blind: No semantic task or decoded token text enters view construction, compression, clustering, or candidate selection.
hypotheses.A1_model_derived_clusters_recur: At least two of three views beat their coordinate-binding null in at least six of eight layers at k=4.
hypotheses.A2_one_cluster_ontology_spans_views: Median adjusted Rand agreement among activation-allocation, exact-write, and CE-allocation partitions is at least 0.50 in at least six layers.
hypotheses.A3_clusters_are_not_coarse_label_restate: At least 75% of primary view-layer partitions have maximum adjusted Rand agreement below 0.25 with current-token form, next-token form, position, or loss quartile.
hypotheses.A4_discrete_codes_beat_continuous_subspa: Frozen k=4 centroid reconstruction beats a frozen rank-4 continuous subspace in at least half of view-layer cells.
hypotheses.A5_k4_is_a_privileged_vocabulary: k=4 center recurrence exceeds both k=2 and k=8 by at least 0.05 in at least half of view-layer cells.
hypotheses.A6_replicated_unlabeled_candidates_exist: At least eight cluster candidates have center cosine at least 0.75 and at least 50 discovery and frozen-replication members.
